**Ollie's Celebrates 700th Store Opening with Book Donation to Gillette Children's**


On September 24, 2026, Ollie's held the Grand Opening of its 700th store! Located in Maplewood, Minnesota the new location represents a major milestone in Ollie's Midwest expansion, bringing Good Stuff Cheap® to the people of Minnesota & beyond!


“Since our start, Ollie’s has been passionately committed to serving communities by delivering extreme value on products people want and need,” said Eric van der Valk, President and Chief Executive Officer of Ollie’s. "Ollie’s offers real bargains on real brands in a thrilling, fun, and quirky environment that is like no other in retail. We’re especially proud to celebrate this milestone in Minnesota, a testament to how customers are loving what Ollie’s offers across the Midwest, and to celebrate this achievement by supporting Children’s Miracle Network and the life-changing work they do for children and families.”


In honor of reaching 700 stores, Ollie’s is donating 700 books to Gillette Children’s through Children’s Miracle Network. The donation, symbolizing one book for every Ollie’s location, will help stock the hospital’s new book nook and create opportunities for patients and families to read, learn, and connect during their time at Gillette Children’s.
